title: G(3,10) = 57? Piece: first gaps (5, 10)
statement: Decide by exhaustive search whether there is a set 0 = x1 < x2 < ... < x57 of 57 integers with every consecutive gap in 1..10, no three elements in arithmetic progression, x2 - x1 = 5 and x3 - x2 = 10. Report None if there is none, or the set.

inputs.whole_problem: If all 90 pieces return None, G(3,10) = 57 (a 56-element set is known: answer/witness/G_s10_56elements.txt). Brown, Landman and Robertson's 2007 table leaves G(3,10) as '?'.
inputs.expected_cost: about 1 CPU-hour per piece on average with a good search; pieces vary widely
